messages:
Ravi K.: Vendor ping: unexpected capacity squeeze. H100 lead time moving +5 weeks, spot air limited. They're proposing an interim split: pull 10 units from EU stock now, rest ship consolidated in 2 weeks. Also proposing single RMA AWB for returns to reduce handling. Thoughts?
Sofia - Supply: Do we have EU stock that can be reallocated without breaking current commitments? Which pool would be affected?
Danny (Ops): EU spare pool has ~14 available but 6 are reserved for enterprise Dedicated renewals. We could reassign 8 if we push renewals by 72h. That avoids urgent air costs.
Tara - Product: If reassigning hurts renewals SLA we need to communicate to customers. Any downtime risk?
Ravi K.: VendorPortal Bot: ZenithX: EU immediate pick 10 units, remainder hold for consolidated shipment ETA +14 days. Return AWB consolidation optional. Surcharge estimate +10% on sea/air mix.
Danny (Ops): Reassign plan: 8 from EU spare + 2 from buffer pool (non-customer reserved). DP: will accept, but depot routing needs clear tags to separate DOA processing. Single AWB for RMAs: reduces customs lines but depot batching increases inspection queue time ~240h.
Sofia - Supply: Cost calc: air express for 10 would be +$14k. Using EU stock = $0 extra but we take some reorder risk. Consolidation surcharge = $4.2k. Net savings ~ $9.8k vs air.
Tara - Product: Can we do a hybrid: EU pull 6 urgent, 4 air express. That reduces reorder exposure and still accelerates 6 urgent reservations.
Ravi K.: We also need RMA policy clarified. Vendor wants returns under one AWB to go to their central repair depot. Our legal asks: 1) vendor retains liability for manifest errors, 2) vendor supplies pre-populated manifest CSV and scanned serial photos.
VendorPortal Bot: ZenithX: Accepts pre-populated manifest and photos. Liability clause requires signature; proposes 30-day SLA on manifest disputes.
Danny (Ops): Depot note: central repair depot requires per-unit RMA labels even if AWB consolidated. Ask vendor to attach individual RMA QR stickers. That saves manual relabeling.
Carrier - SeawayExpress: We can do the mix. Sea slot opens in 11 days, air uplift earliest 1796030000. Consolidated AWB example: SEWAWB000123456. We can add "expedite-clearing" service 80 to speed customs.
Sofia - Supply: Add 80 expedite-clearing to vendor negotiation ask. Also push vendor for 48h manifest hold to match depot intake window.
Tara - Product: If we do 6 EU pull + 4 air, notify impacted customers ASAP and offer 24h credits for any SLA hit.
Ravi K.: Action items: 1) Sofia to negotiate surcharge waiver on first consolidated shipment and cover 80 expedite fee, 2) Danny to confirm depot staffing window for arrival dates, 3) Tara to draft customer comm.
Sofia - Supply: On it. I'll ask vendor for: a) waive 50% of surcharge for this pull, b) provide per-unit QR labels and photos, c) accept liability for customs manifest errors.
Danny (Ops): Quick manifest template we shared with vendor: 
```
manifest_id,sku,qty,serials,rma_id,awb,arrival_date
M-1796,H100,6,SX1001,SX1002,SX1003,RMA-EU-112,SEWAWB000123456,1796027000
```
Ravi K.: Perfect. Please post vendor reply once they accept. Keep replies short here. :white_check_mark:
